title: Advocacy, Passion & Beyond: Voices from the SI Leader Lab
author: Feminism in India
description: In this podcast, we explore various ways in which activists have taken on the challenge and used digital tools to continue doing their work. We talk to leaders and activists across Eastern Europe, South Asia and the MENA region, to understand the challenges they have faced in the past years and how they have worked around the limitations to continue the fight for social justice.
